purpose: Map every owner-approved PPIA-16 cockpit concern and DT-001 through DT-010 surface to an initial screen and end-to-end operator workflow before detailed interaction contracts are authored.

workflows.name: Resume Interrupted Governed Work
workflows.entry: Developer Cockpit Overview or direct restart
steps: Read current pointer and active checkpoint.
Inspect named governed branch/open PR and evidence newer than the pointer timestamp.
Compare active branch state with main when unfinished.
Identify exact active substep, next action, blockers and completion gate.
Surface conflicts/staleness instead of merging them silently.
Navigate to the exact unfinished tool/workflow.
workflows.success_oracle: One exact unfinished operation is recovered from repository evidence; no completion is inferred from conversation history or branch/PR existence.

workflows.name: Assess Repository Readiness and Scope
steps: Resolve governing work item, repository, branch/ref and stop conditions.
Run DT-001 doctor.
Run DT-002 preflight for A2 only when A2 is the relevant application work item.
Present PASS/WARN/BLOCK findings with raw semantics.
Show exact changed-path authority if available; otherwise show the gap/preliminary roots as non-authoritative.
Produce a deterministic readiness/next-action summary.
workflows.success_oracle: Readiness state is source-bound and does not activate implementation or promote preliminary scope authority.

workflows.name: Prepare a Bounded AI/Codex Task
steps: Select an already governed slice/work item.
Refresh relevant doctor/preflight state.
Render DT-003 task capsule.
Show PREPARED/READY_TO_EXECUTE/BLOCKED plus exact reasons.
Require explicit output destination for file writes and explicit force semantics for overwrite.
Hand off only the selected bounded task packet.
workflows.success_oracle: Generated packet preserves source authority, allowed scope, validations and stop conditions and is not described as governance authority.

workflows.name: Inspect and Project Governed Fixtures
steps: Select fixture source and show provenance/class.
Verify fixture set.
Optionally normalize to an explicit output.
Project for a selected role.
Show only role-safe record/field counts and authoritative=false projection state.
Block class/identity/provenance contradictions instead of repairing them silently.
workflows.success_oracle: Canonical, synthetic_qa, campaign_local and source_only boundaries remain intact and hidden data does not leak into projections/counts.

workflows.name: Run Deterministic Scenario and Replay
steps: Verify scenario against fixture set.
Run ordered steps through the selected adapter.
Display PASS/FAIL/BLOCK, step observations and checkpoint digests.
Run replay when requested.
Compare deterministic whole-run evidence.
If authoritative mutation is required but no owning-domain adapter exists, BLOCK rather than simulate mutation.
workflows.success_oracle: Evidence is deterministic and role-safe; mutation boundary is explicit.

workflows.name: Scan Permission/Hidden-Information Leakage
steps: Select validated fixtures, roles and optional scenario.
Run DT-006 privacy scan.
Show cardinality, record, field, identifier, authorization-metadata and scenario-evidence findings.
Preserve caller-known identifier exception semantics.
Treat any scanner finding as blocking for the supplied scan scope.
Do not label PASS as production security certification.
workflows.success_oracle: No supplied projection/evidence leak is hidden or downgraded; scope limitations remain visible.

workflows.name: Capture or Harvest Exact-Candidate UI Evidence
steps: Verify capture plan.
Bind exact candidate SHA.
Choose harvest-existing or explicit browser-adapter run.
Verify PNG dimensions/signature and metadata/attestations.
Generate item and receipt digests.
Mark synthetic CI images as tool-test-only.
workflows.success_oracle: Receipt is bound to the exact candidate and planned evidence; stale or synthetic tool-test evidence cannot satisfy product gates.

workflows.name: Audit and Ratchet Design-System Compliance
steps: Run full DT-008 audit and display legacy WARN debt.
For a candidate change, run changed-since exact base SHA.
Show MVDS001-MVDS010 findings and fingerprints.
BLOCK newly added violations.
Link complementary accessibility/privacy/UI-evidence surfaces for requirements DT-008 cannot prove.
workflows.success_oracle: Existing debt remains visible and new violations cannot be silently added; static lint scope is not overstated.

workflows.name: Explore Traceability and Proof
steps: Compile relevant source roots and explicit manifests.
Query stable ID.
Show occurrences separately from structured relations.
Show UNDECLARED/DECLARED/PROVEN with candidate/evidence integrity fields.
Open implementing/verifying/evidencing target.
Never convert textual co-occurrence into proof or PROVEN into work-item completion.
workflows.success_oracle: Proof state derives only from integrity-valid explicit relations and exact candidate/evidence identity.

workflows.name: Run Recovery and Performance Evidence
steps: Verify DT-010 plan.
Classify cases as reference probe, scenario replay, explicit external adapter or performance probe.
Require adapter when the case contract requires real application/service behavior.
Require numerical performance budget plus budget_source.
Run and show PASS/FAIL/BLOCK, functional digest, samples and violations.
Preserve reference-vs-product evidence scope.
workflows.success_oracle: No reference probe or tool timing is promoted into product recovery/performance authority.

workflows.name: Review Exact-Head CI and Evidence Gate
steps: Select exact candidate SHA and governing completion gate.
Enumerate all applicable hosted workflows for that head.
Inspect dedicated gate and failed jobs/logs as needed.
Associate candidate-bound UI/trace/recovery/tool receipts.
Distinguish current failures from historical failure-index records.
Present completion eligibility only when every declared evidence kind/validation is satisfied.
workflows.success_oracle: Partial green state cannot appear as final exact-head success; stale evidence remains visibly stale.

workflows.name: Triage Blocking Finding and Recover Next Action
steps: Open raw finding/run/source and bind it to current candidate/input.
Determine whether it changes the active recovery path or is historical/nonblocking.
If repairable under current authority, identify the smallest owning scope and targeted rerun.
If owner-only/irreversible, surface the exact gate without executing it.
If state becomes contradictory or work must stop, update the governed checkpoint at the milestone boundary.
Return to the exact next unfinished action.
workflows.success_oracle: Finding disposition preserves raw evidence, authority and checkpoint cadence; unresolved required failures remain unfinished.
workflows.mutation: none unless separately governed repair is authorized

next_design_boundary: Detailed screen states, action enablement/confirmation rules, component interaction contracts, keyboard/mobile behavior, empty/loading/error/recovery variants and deterministic screen/workflow reference cases belong to the next PPIA-16 bounded substep.
